title: Megalodon GitHub Actions Base64-Encoded Workflow Payload Burst -- T1195.002 (H Wave 8 Front 4)
author: WRG-11
description:
Detects the Megalodon supply-chain composite TTP burst pattern: 6-hour burst window + 50+ throwaway-email-registered accounts + base64 encoded GitHub Actions workflow payload + mass push/PR to victim repositories.
Attack chain (H Wave 8 Front 4 Megalodon profile):
(1) Threat actor (TeamPCP / UNC6780 cluster per internal) bulk-registers 50+ GitHub accounts using throwaway/disposable email providers (10minutemail, mailinator, guerrillamail, temp-mail style addresses) within a 6-hour window.
(2) Each throwaway account opens 1-5 PRs (or pushes commits) to victim open-source repositories. The PR/commit content modifies `.github/workflows/<existing-or-new>.yml` to inject a base64-encoded step payload (e.g., `run: echo <base64-blob> | base64 -d | bash`).
(3) GitHub Actions executes the base64 payload on PR-trigger or push- trigger, sweeping credentials (GITHUB_TOKEN, secrets, env vars) and exfiltrating via HTTPS POST OR DNS tunneling fallback (sister to template_t1071_004_dns_tunneling_exfil_high_volume_unique_subdomain.yml Megalodon Variant C).
(4) Net effect = mass supply-chain compromise across many OSS repos in a single burst window. Sister incident: internal (composite burst + throwaway-email-account cluster).
Detection logic (SIEM aggregation required for full burst window composite):
- github.audit logsource (or equivalent enterprise audit log) - action == workflow_run (or workflow_dispatch + push to .github/workflows/*) - workflow_ref (or commit content) matches base64 step pattern `(echo|printf)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/]{50,}\s*\|\s*base64\s+-d\s*\|\s*(bash|sh|pwsh|powershell)` - WITHIN a 6-hour rolling window, account creation count >= 50 with throwaway email domains (mailinator|guerrillamail|10minutemail|temp-mail|...)
Sister cluster: observed_clawhavoc_claude_skills_t1195_002.yml + observed_nx_console_t1195_002.yml + observed_s1ngularity_nx_npm_token _exfil_t1195_002.yml + observed_mini_shai_hulud_npm_supply_chain_c2_ t1071.yml (4-vector Nx campaign cluster; this rule = 5th sister vector Megalodon GitHub Actions branch).
Source: Tier 0 H Wave 8 Front 4 Megalodon profile (internal Front 4).
